explain.en: Packages npm has downloaded. npm fetches them again when a project needs them; installed node_modules folders are not affected.
explain.zh: npm 下载过的包。项目需要时 npm 会重新下载，已经装好的 node_modules 不受影响。

evidence.note: Present on the maintainer's Mac: ~/.npm/_cacache 3.9G; `npm config get cache` (npm 10.9.8) prints ~/.npm. macOS 26.6.2.

notes: npm's docs: cache data lives in `_cacache` inside the configured `cache`, and `npm cache clean` deletes it. A `cache=` line in ~/.npmrc is not followed yet. ~/.npm/_npx (npx installs) is a separate folder this rule does not cover. npm reads npm_config_* environment variables case-insensitively (docs.npmjs.com/cli/v10/using-npm/config).
